selection_method: Current product documentation and release-specific guides were searched for every target. Primary topics were selected from administration/configuration/new-features/architecture/deployment sources, not from Community troubleshooting articles.
direct_open_limit: Several docs.fortinet.com pages returned HTTP 403 when opened directly. Their indexed official Fortinet documentation content was inspected, canonical URLs were retained, and this limitation is disclosed in the report.
